typed.actual: Native per-tsconfig semantic workspace over Git-authored compiler roots, including package source and roots, tests, scripts, MTS, and Playwright TSX; imported dependencies may exist in program closures but sourceCorpus exposes authored roots only.
typed.testSemantics: Tests are loaded and explicitly bucketed by liveness consumers; individual lenses decide whether tests keep declarations alive, form a distinct finding class, or are excluded.

syntactic.actual: harnessGlobs: packages/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}, tooling/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, scripts/**/*.{ts,tsx}, excluding scripts/probes/st-goldens/sillytavern-runtime/**.
syntactic.testSemantics: Tests are loaded. Search helpers report them unless the operation supplies an explicit test-file skip rule.

wideSyntactic.actual: The syntactic corpus plus packages/*/*.ts, packages/*/src/**/*.mts, tests/**/*.mts, and playwright/**/*.tsx, without a type graph.
wideSyntactic.testSemantics: Designed for literal sweeps across production and fixtures; tests are intentionally searchable.

depcruise.actual: dependency-cruiser packages graph using .dependency-cruiser.cjs; AST scan count is n/a and matches count deduped text edge lines.
depcruise.testSemantics: Whatever the dependency-cruiser config admits; the AST prod/test liveness buckets do not apply.

verbs.rootSemantics: Unions references from every native program containing each matched declaration and dedupes by physical path/span.
verbs.limitations: Declaration discovery is name-based and may return multiple same-named declarations; no focused cmdRefs output test exists. Dynamic/computed usage that TypeScript cannot reference is invisible.

verbs.rootSemantics: Tests and production files are searched equally; no prod/test classification.
verbs.limitations: Matches callee text or property tail only. Same-named methods on unrelated receivers are pooled; aliases and indirect calls are not followed.

verbs.rootSemantics: Compares direct and recognized client mutation doors across loaded production and test syntax; unresolved/escaping doors are named rather than treated clean.
verbs.limitations: Requires at least two comparable sites; spreads/computed keys and escaped destructured fires are unjudged. Use a verb/hook name, not generic mutate/call.

verbs.rootSemantics: Searches production and tests without classifying them.
verbs.limitations: Static imports match raw specifier or whatever getModuleSpecifierSourceFile resolves in a no-tsconfig Project; dynamic imports match literal specifier text only. No focused test pins alias-to-path resolution.

verbs.rootSemantics: Enumerates resolved exported declarations from every matched loaded file; test paths can be targeted explicitly.
verbs.limitations: The scope is substring-based; re-exported declarations appear by the exporting file's surface but point to origin declarations.

verbs.rootSemantics: Production and test TSX are searched equally.
verbs.limitations: Exact tag text only; imported aliases, member components, and semantically equivalent wrappers are distinct spellings.

verbs.rootSemantics: Production, tests, tooling, and scripts in harnessGlobs are all searched.
verbs.limitations: Raw identifier spelling only; declarations, unrelated shadows, and property names all count. Comments and strings do not. Current CLI zero caveat incorrectly says general scripts are excluded.

verbs.rootSemantics: Intentionally searches production, tests, fixtures, scripts, package roots, MTS, and Playwright TSX.
verbs.limitations: Substring match within string literals and static template chunks; interpolated holes, comments, and identifiers are excluded.

verbs.rootSemantics: Separates production references from test-path references; re-export pass-through is not consumption. Verdict priority is ALIVE, SWALLOWED-ONLY, TAGGED-KEEP, TEST-ANCHORED, CANDIDATE.
verbs.limitations: Same-name declarations are each classified. Marker and vendored/comment arms are context, not proof. A TEST-ANCHORED result requires testonly/application review, not deletion.

verbs.rootSemantics: Any production import, any test import, or declaration-identity same-file use keeps an export alive. Test-only code therefore is deliberately not an orphan.
verbs.limitations: Use testonly for test-kept-alive exports. Namespace/dynamic imports err alive. Export-star targets are named as suppressed candidates rather than hits, so barrels require manual review.

verbs.rootSemantics: Reports exports reached by tests but not production or same-file production use; __-prefixed declared test seams are named in a non-hit bucket.
verbs.limitations: A test import proves test anchoring, not intended deletion. Namespace/dynamic imports can conservatively make an export production-alive.

verbs.rootSemantics: File reachability starts from package.json exports, knip workspace entries, package scripts, and explicit production anchors. Tests are neither entries nor graph nodes; test-only-reachable files are findings.
verbs.limitations: File-level only. Dynamic resolution is limited to recognized static/literal forms; missing declared anchors refuse the run. A package subpath intended solely as a test helper is expected to appear.

verbs.rootSemantics: Builds a resolved static import/export graph only within packages/<pkg>/src.
verbs.limitations: No focused test. Ignores dynamic imports and cross-package cycles; reports DFS-discovered cycles without canonical cycle deduplication guarantees.

verbs.rootSemantics: Production and tests in the matched path are inventoried without classification.
verbs.limitations: Syntax patterns only: named import/export aliases, exported const Y = X, and nongeneric bare type Y = X. It does not decide whether an alias is harmful or follow semantic equivalence.

verbs.rootSemantics: Server procedure declarations are compared only with non-test client production trpc chains and Trpc indexed-access inference.
verbs.limitations: Structural router/proxy grammars only; alternate wrappers or generated/runtime dispatch are blind spots. Zero enumerated procedures is a tool error. Marked fixtures require intent review.

verbs.rootSemantics: Requires server-production consumption and excludes client-production and test consumption. Default contracts scope narrows to *View/*Summary names.
verbs.limitations: Import-liveness can miss tRPC inference or barrel-mediated client use. A hit may be a real wire gap or an unmodeled proxy consumer; verify with unwired/viewgap and source.

verbs.rootSemantics: Owners come from contracts/server production *View/*Summary declarations; readers are non-test packages/client/src files only.
verbs.limitations: Reads are name-matched, not type-resolved, so unrelated same-named fields hide findings. Object spreads, computed keys, whole-object generic renderers, and UI-package renames are invisible. Empty client reader corpus refuses.

verbs.rootSemantics: A named import in production or tests, same-file use, or an explicit namespace member read removes the candidate; remaining exports are alive only through whole-module namespace consumption.
verbs.limitations: The swallowing API may genuinely consume every export. Member detection covers dot, literal bracket, and destructuring shapes but runtime reflection/computed reads remain unprovable.

verbs.rootSemantics: Compares server domain contract shapes with sibling @orb/contracts domain shapes in co-located native programs; tests are not the shape homes.
verbs.limitations: Exact means mutual assignability, not shared runtime schema identity. Near mode is field/type-text Jaccard with a four-field floor. Generic/type-query derivations are exempt only when provenance matches; distinct validation refinements still require source review.

verbs.rootSemantics: Classifies all references by position, including tests; candidates have references but every reference is type-position. Unreferenced exports belong to orphans.
verbs.limitations: A runtime schema intentionally used through typeof/z.infer can be a real validation/type twin rather than dead runtime code; inspect the schema producer and parser uses before acting. Slow per-export reference resolution.

verbs.rootSemantics: Schema columns are production declarations; read references span the loaded workspace, while writes are structural insert/update/set sites. Tests can contribute references unless filtered by the collector's specific path rules.
verbs.limitations: Whole-row/spread writers yield write? rather than unwritten. Raw SQL name evidence is table-agnostic and over-inclusive. Inferred row writes require structural recognition; each column incurs reference resolution.

verbs.rootSemantics: Registry definitions and consumers exclude test paths; same-file qualified property reads count, while the row declaration itself does not.
verbs.limitations: DB/URL/runtime keys, iteration, template-built keys, CSS derivation, and same-value different spelling can look dead. Never gates and has no exemption marker.

verbs.rootSemantics: Only non-test, non-declaration production source files participate.
verbs.limitations: Convention heuristics for contributions, literal sets, shared namespace mutation, and drifted twins; a hit is an architecture prompt, not proof of a missing registry.

verbs.rootSemantics: Field declarations come from packages/contracts/src; producer/consumer indexes exclude tests so fixtures do not keep a field alive.
verbs.limitations: Name-based across shapes; template paths, spreads, foreign/guest/model-produced keys, and composition aliases need explicit fences. A same-named producer hides a finding; a generated producer can create one.

verbs.rootSemantics: Audits non-test packages/*/src declarations. Tests, scripts/configs outside package src, module-scope side effects, reasoned public markers, and every UI export are alive roots.
verbs.limitations: Declaration-consumer attribution is syntactic/name-based. A missed dynamic/registry/proxy edge can make an entire live subtree look dead. Completely unreferenced heads remain orphans rather than duplicate chain hits.

verbs.rootSemantics: Examines aliases under package source; usage/test roots do not affect whether an alias resolves exactly to string.
verbs.limitations: Reports semantic weakness, not deadness. A domain may deliberately use a documentary alias; no exemption marker or gate. Literal unions, templates, brands, and unions containing string are excluded.

verbs.rootSemantics: Separates cross-package production/tooling consumers, own-package production consumers, tests, and no consumers into PUBLIC, INTERNAL, TEST-ONLY, and UNUSED.
verbs.limitations: INTERNAL does not prove a barrel export is wrong. UNUSED inherits orphan star suppression. Namespace or dynamic whole-module consumption promotes exports conservatively; pair with swallowed.

verbs.rootSemantics: One native workspace/liveness build feeds orphans, testonly, chains, typeonly-alive, and swallowed collectors with their existing prod/test semantics.
verbs.limitations: Does not reproduce each standalone lens's marker staleness, suppression buckets, or full narration. Use it to choose follow-up lenses, never as the final deletion verdict.

verbs.rootSemantics: Uses dependency-cruiser config rather than AST liveness buckets; returns direct edges both ways around the focus.
verbs.limitations: Text edge dump only, not a dependency-rule verdict. No positive focused output test; duplicate edge lines are collapsed.

verbs.rootSemantics: Uses dependency-cruiser config to list modules that can transitively reach the subject; prod/test distinctions are config-defined.
verbs.limitations: No focused test. Text graph dump, not a rule verdict; runtime/computed edges outside dependency-cruiser's resolver remain invisible.

worktreeFixesAfterInventory.result: Corpus receipts now derive standard and wide syntax labels from shared glob authorities; typed receipts name native per-tsconfig authored roots; help states per-verb semantic vs spelling behavior.
Contract-field producer discovery recognizes TypeScript assignment operators = through ??=/compound forms for dot and literal-index targets.
Generic hit emission preserves distinct same-file/line/kind records by rendered text while collapsing exact duplicate records.

followUpSafety: Before deleting code based on nonpresence, corroborate the lens with actual ast-grep over TS and TSX, record scanned scope/count, and review the declaration plus callers. No in-repo probe files.
